ios.desc:
Gazzetta is the best way to read news and links on Mastodon.

Follow servers (e.g. mastodon.social) and see all the trending links.

Follow accounts (e.g. kottke@mastodon.social) and see all the links posted by those accounts.

Login to your own accounts and see all the links in your timeline.

Search for servers by domain (e.g. mastodon.social), and accounts by webfinger (e.g. kottke@mastodon.social).

Search the news and links to find the content you want.

Read all the news items in Safari in-app, with access to all your passwords and extensions.

Add links to Bookmarks, Favorites and Reading List.

Add links to Safari's Reading List, if you prefer.

Export your Bookmarks, Favorites and Reading List as an HTML document.

Filter links by domains, keywords, and languages. Temporarily disable filters.

Customize your experience:
	- Custom font styles and sizes.
	- Hide thumbnails and icons.
	- Hide authors, comments, dates, descriptions, publishers, sources.
	- Limit the length of descriptions and titles.

Data Settings:
	- Disable image downloads
	- Disable inifinite scrolling

https://primatology.xyz/privacy-policy
